description: This file defines the 'GlobalFirstPartySets' class, which manages information about First-Party Sets in a browser context, including methods for querying, modifying, and iterating over set entries, as well as handling configurations and metadata related to First-Party Sets.

classes.name: GlobalFirstPartySets
classes.description: Manages the collection of First-Party Sets, providing methods for querying, iteration, and configuration management.
